title: Remove acceptance-evaluation unsettled-submission counters when their attempt ends without an admitted write
outcome: An entry in StateInner::acceptance_evaluation_unsettled_submissions (src/state.rs; maintained by acceptance_evaluation_root_refusal_locked in src/engram_source_roots.rs) is removed not only when a write is admitted, but also when its attempt can no longer submit: the limit refusal is issued, the evaluation's delegation is cancelled, retired or finished, or reuse replaces the target with a new attempt key (acceptance_evaluation_reuse.rs:234-236). The bound still holds for attempts that remain able to submit.
acceptance: A regression test shows that replacing, retiring or finally refusing an attempt removes its counter, while an attempt that can still submit keeps its count toward the limit.
disposal_reason: Fable2 #1217 triage at master 8f544b4553a14b87a0c7a55fb82d67e91d71d825: obsolete — Removed unsettled-submission map means replacement/terminal counter leak no longer has a live owner. Source: src/state.rs; src/engram_source_roots.rs. Work planning only; no historical evaluation, verification or seal changed.
